
== Japanese A New Hope printing ==
The collecting encyclopedia, p. 101, index 4215, confirms this Light Side, black-border, nonfoil Character publication and rarity; p. 42 dates its Japanese Limited edition to September 1997. <ref name="encyclopedia-172-anh">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101.</ref> The English display name and printing ID <code>1302_3o</code> follow the approved identity mapping. The source index is not the printing ID. Missing data: a verified full-resolution Japanese card face; Japanese printed title, lore, game text, subtype, uniqueness, symbols and statistics; translation and wording comparison. The product illustration on p. 42 includes a small Japanese Chewbacca face, but this batch has not established a readable full-card transcription from it. No native-title alias, gameplay-equivalence claim or GEMP implementation claim is made. Source preservation has not yet been verified. == Recovered Japanese source face ==
Recovered the original Japanese face as exact embedded JPEG bytes from the collecting encyclopedia, p. 42, xref 2048 (1224×1707). <ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Full face and complete title/lore/statistics/game-icon regions were inspected before comparison. Japanese transcription and a separately labeled AI English reading aid are now proposed. The Japanese last sentence names vehicles and droids; the English printed face names “your vehicles, starships and droids.” The Japanese sentence has no word corresponding to “your” and uses 位置カード (location card), whereas the English face says “same site.” For Millennium Falcon, the Japanese text says “aboard”; the English face says “On Millennium Falcon.” The Japanese printing also uses deck terminology where the English printing says Used Pile and Lost Pile. The printed numerical statistics, Alien/Rebel symbols, Pilot symbol and Warrior symbol match the inspected English face. Character landspeed 1 is kept separate as rule-derived; no Japanese-specific engine implementation or new state is assigned. The earlier missing-face entry describes the previous evidence state and is retained. The retained preserved encyclopedia copy has a matching SHA-256.
